style: Friendly rounded flat vector illustration: a dark base colour (#2b2416), one accent colour (#44b2d7) and white, simple clean shapes, no text, no people, no hands.

subjects.inspection-mecanique: A clipboard checklist, a flashlight and a tire tread gauge in front of a car wheel on a lift. No hands, no people.
subjects.alignement: A plain rounded generic compact car on an alignment rack with wheel alignment targets clamped on the wheels. Generic invented vehicle design: plain simple grille with no bars pattern of any real brand, no badges, no emblems, no lettering.

hero: A local repair garage interior: an SUV on a lift, a parts shelf with boxes, a creeper and a floor jack; through a high window, forested Laurentian hills in the distance. Flat vector, DARK overall (#2b2416), accent highlights (#44b2d7), white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no hands, no numbers. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges or emblems.
